extensionDesc.message: Redirects to a hidden WordPress login page when double pressing Shift keyboard key.

welcomeMessage.message: Welcome to 2xShift Goto secret wp-admin! On a WordPress site where you are not logged in, double-pressing Shift offers to remember the admin access for that site.

explainations.message: In order to avoid unexpected redirection to a site that would require pressing the Shift key several times quickly, the script detects whether the site we are browsing is a WordPress site by checking for the presence of wp-content wp-includes or wp-admin strings in the source code of the page.
